title: Connecting the Dots in Agentic AI Security: A Cross-Dimensional Threat Taxonomy, Evaluation Maturity, and Open Challenges
abstract: arXiv:2609.23894v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic AI extends LLM security beyond generated content to persistent state, autonomous actions, tool use, and interactions with humans and other agents. Existing threat classifications often emphasize individual dimensions, obscuring connections among entry points, affected components, and security consequences. The known threat landscape also differs from the coverage demonstrated by empirical research. Through a structured review of 66 studies published from 2022 to 2026, we introduce T={S, B, P, A}, a cross-dimensional representation linking affected functional or system surfaces {S}, interaction or trust boundaries {B}, violated security properties {P}, and empirically examined architectures {A}. We analyze 22 artifact-backed red-teaming studies and 11 representative security benchmarks to characterize empirical coverage and evaluation maturity. translated_abstract: 智能体AI将大语言模型的安全问题从生成内容扩展到持久状态、自主行动、工具使用以及与人类和其他智能体的交互。现有的威胁分类往往只强调单一维度，掩盖了入口点、受影响组件与安全后果之间的联系。此外，已知的威胁态势与实证研究所展示的覆盖范围也存在差异。通过对2022年至2026年发表的66项研究进行结构化综述，我们提出了T={S, B, P, A}这一跨维度表示法，将受影响的功能或系统层面{S}、交互或信任边界{B}、被违反的安全属性{P}以及经实证检验的架构{A}联系起来。我们分析了22项有实证产物支持的红队测试研究和11个代表性安全基准，以刻画实证覆盖范围与评估成熟度。在所选研究中，证据集中于提示/推理、记忆以及t……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个连接系统层面、信任边界、安全属性与实证架构的跨维度智能体AI安全威胁分类框架T={S,B,P,A}，并通过分析66项研究、红队测试和安全基准，揭示了当前实证评估的覆盖差距与成熟度不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces T={S,B,P,A}, a cross-dimensional threat taxonomy for agentic AI security linking system surfaces, trust boundaries, security properties, and empirically examined architectures, and reveals gaps in empirical coverage and evaluation maturity through a structured review of 66 studies, red-teaming research, and security benchmarks.
